extended_actions.why: Discrete axe selection (key 1); gb_action alone infers the tool from the facing tile and cannot pick the axe on a plot that also accepts a hoe or seed.
Discrete hoe selection (key 2) for tilling before planting, independent of the facing-tile inference.
Discrete watering-can selection (key 3) so a planted plot can be watered without re-inferring the tool.
Discrete corn-seed selection (key 4); the two seed kinds are only distinguishable by explicit selection.
Discrete tomato-seed selection (key 5); the two seed kinds are only distinguishable by explicit selection.
